errors.evidence: The description states that the grey line for Общинска банка is at about 6.5-7% around 2016-2017, but the figure shows it is stable at approximately 6% during that period.
The description states that the yellow line for Интернешънъл Асет Банк reaches about 12% in 2009, but the graph shows its peak is clearly higher, at approximately 13%.

This describes the light blue line for Д Банк. While the value is around 10% in 2011, this is not the bottom of the dip. The line continues to fall to its minimum of about 8.5% around 2014. The description incorrectly identifies 2011 as the time of the minimum value.
